explication: Argo CD is a declarative GitOps continuous-delivery platform for Kubernetes. A user defines or updates an Application through the UI, CLI, or API; the API persists the desired application configuration, the repo server obtains source content and generates manifests, and the application controller compares desired and live state and applies changes through the GitOps engine. ApplicationSets generate Applications from cluster, Git, pull-request, and other inputs; notifications, authentication, and cluster/repository management are additional product capabilities. The map reflects the provided tree, README, and sampled excerpts; some subsystem wiring is omitted where source excerpts do not establish it.
